mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM topic_class_progress p JOIN course_topics t ON t.topic_id = p.topic_id AND t.user_id = p.user_id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE p.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.class_seq IS NULL, p.class_seq, p.week_no IS NULL, p.week_no, p.topic_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic_class_progress (user_id, course_id, topic_id, class_seq, week_no, source, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{topicId}, #{classSeq}, #{weekNo}, 'USER', #{note}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE class_seq = COALESCE(VALUES(class_seq), class_seq), week_no = COALESCE(VALUES(week_no), week_no), note = COALESCE(VALUES(note), note)
mapper.update: UPDATE topic_class_progress SET class_seq = #{classSeq} WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM topic_class_progress WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND topic_id = #{topicId}
mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM course_scope_exclusions e JOIN course_topics t ON t.topic_id = e.topic_id AND t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY e.created_at, e.exclusion_id

SELECT e.* FROM course_scope_exclusions e JOIN course_topics t ON t.topic_id = e.topic_id AND t.user_id = e.user_id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.course_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_scope_exclusions (user_id, course_id, topic_id, label, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{topicId}, #{label}, 'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 'ACTIVE', removed_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE course_scope_exclusions SET status = 'REMOVED', removed_at = NOW() WHERE exclusion_id = #{exclusionId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT t.topic_id AS topicId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_items e WHERE e.topic_id = t.topic_id AND e.user_id = t.user_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.status IN ('PLANNED', 'HOLD')) AS openItems, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_items e WHERE e.topic_id = t.topic_id AND e.user_id = t.user_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.status = 'DONE') AS doneItems, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_contexts c WHERE c.topic_id = t.topic_id AND c.user_id = t.user_id AND c.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'STALE')) AS contexts, (SELECT p.status FROM topic_progress p WHERE p.topic_id = t.topic_id AND p.user_id = t.user_id ORDER BY p.topic_progress_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS progress FROM course_topics t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.topic_id IN #{id}
